description: Shows which social networks the team has connected for publishing and which need a reconnect. Use when the user asks where posts can go, why publishing skipped, or whether Instagram, TikTok or others are linked. Not for connecting a channel: that happens in Teams (Social, Channels tab). Returns each platform's status and whether this user can manage channels.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.
